article.headline: Washington and No. 20 Iowa meet in Big Ten play
article.description: No. 20 Iowa (4-1) at Washington (3-2), Oct. 9 at 9 p.m. EDT.
article.title: Washington and No. 20 Iowa meet in Big Ten play
article.linkText: Washington and No. 20 Iowa meet in Big Ten play
article.story: No. 20 Iowa (4-1) at Washington (3-2), Oct. 9 at 9 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Washington by 2.5. Against the spread: Washington 1-4, Iowa 3-2. How to watch: Fox Networks Key stats Washington Offense Overall: 380.4 yards per game (84th in FBS) Passing: 271.4 yards per game (35th) Rushing: 109 yards per game (126th) Scoring: 26.6 points per game (87th) Washington Defense Overall: 303.4 yards per game (34th in FBS) Passing: 192 yards per game (45th) Rushing: 111.4 yards per game (35th) Scoring: 18.4 points per game (37th) Iowa Offense Overall: 390.8 yards per game (73rd in FBS) Passing: 210.6 yards per game (88th) Rushing: 180.2 yards per game (46th) Scoring: 29 points per game (74th) Iowa Defense Overall: 288.6 yards per game (25th in FBS) Passing: 186.4 yards per game (40th) Rushing: 102.2 yards per game (32nd) Scoring: 12.6 points per game (8th) Washington is 130th in third down percentage, converting 29% of the time. Iowa ranks 33rd on defense, holding its opponents to 32.4%. Washington is 14th in the FBS with a +5 turnover margin. Washington ranks 126th in the FBS averaging 77.8 penalty yards per game, compared to Iowa's 38th-ranked 49.4 per-game average. Washington is 89th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 84% of trips. Iowa's red zone defense ranks 9th at 69.2%. Team leaders Washington Passing: Demond Williams Jr., 1,327 yards, 8 TDs, 3 INTs, 67.5 completion percentage Rushing: Brian Bonner Jr., 215 yards on 41 carries, 0 TDs Receiving: Dezmen Roebuck, 338 yards on 35 catches, 1 TD Iowa Passing: Hank Brown, 832 yards, 5 TDs, 1 INT, 62.9 completion percentage Rushing: Kamari Moulton, 311 yards on 50 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Tony Diaz, 306 yards on 25 catches, 1 TD Last game Washington was defeated by USC 25-21 on Oct. 3. Williams led Washington with 198 yards on 15-of-26 passing (57.7%) for one touchdown and no interceptions. He also carried the ball 13 times for 26 yards. Bonner carried the ball 19 times for 89 yards, adding one reception for two yards. Chris Lawson put up 82 yards on five catches. Iowa fell to Ohio State 31-14 on Oct. 3. Brown led Iowa with 132 yards on 12-of-27 passing (44.4%) for no touchdowns and one interception. Moulton had 27 rushing yards on 11 carries. D.J. Vonnahme had six receptions for 64 yards. Next game Washington plays at Purdue on Oct. 16. Iowa plays at Minnesota on Oct. 24.
